body: Parquet cannot currently push down startsWith predicates because it doesn't have a built-in implementation. Iceberg should add a user-defined predicate to push it down.
title: Add Parquet user-defined predicate to push down StartsWith

body: Parquet cannot currently push down IN and NOT_IN predicates because it has no built-in support. Iceberg should include a user-defined predicate that implements these so they can be pushed down.
title: Add Parquet user-defined predicates to push down IN and NOT_IN

body:
Parquet predicates currently do not support push-down on Decimal columns.
This will require detecting the decimal storage and building the correct predicate that uses an integer, long, or binary value.
title: Support Decimal in Parquet predicates

body:
We use SparkTableUtil.importSparkTable to create an iceberg table on parquet data files. The iceberg table schema is built from spark table schema, and the metrics is built from parquet schema and persisted in manifest file. If the two schemas are not same,  when we query the table, the id of the filtered field in iceberg table schema is used to get upper bound from metrics, then we get wrong upper bound or some converting error.
Legacy parquet files may not have consistent schema, so we should not use schema read from parquet footer to build the fleld id in metrics.
